authority.description: Declares an Official Source Erratum; no other authority may correct Effective Rules Text.

field.description: The Card field derived from applicable official Errata.

target_type.description: Card changes Effective Rules Text; Printing preserves a narrower official correction without rewriting Printed Rules Text.

effective_from.description: Inclusive official applicability date, or null when the Official Source gives no date.

official_wording.description: The correction notice as published by the Official Source.

corrected_value.description: The exact Effective Rules Text supplied by the Official Source; null explicitly removes it.
